Stores one chunk at its offset. Chunks may arrive in any order and may be
re-sent; each must have exactly the planned length.

oneOf.description: The chosen cover, else the newest photo; `null` for an empty album.

node_ids.description: 1–500 photo (file node) ids; ids that are not the caller's photos are skipped.

AlbumRef.description: An album a photo belongs to.

AssetDetails.description: Everything the photo viewer shows about one photo.

albums.description: Albums of the caller holding this photo, by name.

id.description: The file node's id (also used by `/api/files/{id}/…`).

width.description: Displayed size, once known. The grid treats unknown as square.

Photos to put in it right away (at most 500); ids that are not the
caller's photos are skipped.

email_hint.description: Optional reminder of who the invitation is for. Not used to send email.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole file, 64 lowercase hex characters.

token.description: Shown once. Build the link as `<origin>/join/<token>`.

kinds.description: Queued, running and failed counts per job kind, kinds sorted.

csrf_token.description: Send back as `X-CSRF-Token` on every non-GET request.

queued.description: Waiting for their first processing step.

path.description: Ancestors from the top-level folder down, excluding the node itself.

mime.description: Detected from the content at upload; `null` for folders.

items.description: Folders first, then files; names in byte order.

used_bytes.description: Logical bytes of live files: what the quota limits.

blurhash.description: A compact blurred placeholder (blurha.sh) to show while it loads.
